title: polygala vulgaris var. collina
intro: Polygala vulgaris var. collina, commonly known as the common or knavels, is a variety of flowering plant in the milkwort family (Polygalaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Europe, where it is valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Polygala vulgaris var. collina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. The health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant are thought to include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic effects, although more research is needed to fully understand its potential uses.
